product: Jakafi/Jakafi XR (ruxolitinib) in myelofibrosis, polycythemia vera and GVHD, at 817M Q2 2026 net sales plus 7 percent YoY (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Opzelura cream in atopic dermatitis and vitiligo: 450M reported, about 204M excluding the CMS benefit, plus 24 percent (same). Hematology and Oncology growth products (Niktimvo, Monjuvi/Minjuvi, Zynyz) added 222M, plus 69 percent (same).
demand: Volume and demand led, not price. Q2 2026 total net sales rose 40 percent, but 17 percent excluding the 246M one-time Opzelura CMS accrual reversal, with every marketed product growing on demand (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Price is the future pressure point: the 2026-08-31 CMS agreement ties Jakafi/Jakafi XR Medicaid pricing to international reference prices (Incyte 8-K, 2026-08-31).
pricing_power: Jakafi loss of exclusivity or early generic entry, gross-to-net erosion, and failed pipeline readouts. Q3 2026 alone carries a roughly 1,270M IPR&D expense, and FY26 GAAP operating expense guidance jumped to 4,915-4,995M from 3,495-3,675M (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Cost of sales was already 7 percent of total net sales in Q2 2026 (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28).
competition: Not found as a specific dated product (2026-09-28). The structural low-cost substitute is generic ruxolitinib after Jakafi exclusivity ends; Incyte guides Jakafi flat at 3,220-3,270M for FY26 (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). No Chinese zilurgisertib or povorcitinib substitute was found in primary sources.
market_strategy: CEO Bill Meury, 2026-07-28 Q2 release: With ten data readouts expected in the second half of 2026, alongside product launches through early next year, we are well positioned for our next phase of growth (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Same release set FY26 total net sales guidance of 5,130-5,260M and Opzelura of 1,050-1,100M (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28).
bull: Q2 2026 net sales rose 40% with FY26 guidance raised to 5,130-5,260M (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28); ten H2 2026 readouts and Atebrioz approval (Mirum 8-K, 2026-09-25) support the growth story.
bear: Q3 2026 carries a ~1,270M IPR&D charge and FY26 opex guidance jumped to 4,915-4,995M; Jakafi is flat at 3,220-3,270M and CMS ties Medicaid pricing to international reference prices (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28/08-31).
falsifier: Q3 2026 report (late Oct-early Nov 2026) cutting FY26 total net sales below 5,130M, Opzelura below 1,050M, or Jakafi missing 3,220-3,270M (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28).
web_what_changed_30_90d: Since the 2026-09-27 card: Mirum filed the Atebrioz 8-K on 2026-09-28 formalizing the 2026-09-25 FDA approval, and J.P. Morgan trimmed its target to 123 (Hold) on 2026-09-28 while H.C. Wainwright went to 152 (stockanalysis, aggregator). Last 30 days: Atebrioz approval for FOP 2026-09-25 (Mirum 8-K, primary). Last 90 days: Q2 net sales 1.49B and raised FY26 guide 2026-07-28, CMS Jakafi agreement 2026-08-31, Vega/latarcibart deal closed 2026-07-06 (Incyte 8-Ks).
web_true_now_not_modelled: Q3 2026 will carry a one-time about 1,270M IPR&D expense from the 1.25B Vega/latarcibart upfront payment, hitting both GAAP and non-GAAP R&D (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). FY26 Opzelura guidance embeds a 246M non-cash CMS accrual reversal, so underlying Q2 Opzelura was about 204M not 450M (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Atebrioz US launch begins October 2026 (Mirum 8-K, 2026-09-28).
web_demand_product: Jakafi/Jakafi XR (ruxolitinib) in myelofibrosis, polycythemia vera and GVHD, at 817M Q2 2026 net sales plus 7 percent YoY (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Opzelura cream in atopic dermatitis and vitiligo: 450M reported, about 204M excluding the CMS benefit, plus 24 percent (same). Hematology and Oncology growth products (Niktimvo, Monjuvi/Minjuvi, Zynyz) added 222M, plus 69 percent (same).
web_price_volume_mix: Volume and demand led, not price. Q2 2026 total net sales rose 40 percent, but 17 percent excluding the 246M one-time Opzelura CMS accrual reversal, with every marketed product growing on demand (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Price is the future pressure point: the 2026-08-31 CMS agreement ties Jakafi/Jakafi XR Medicaid pricing to international reference prices (Incyte 8-K, 2026-08-31).
web_bottleneck: Incyte bottleneck: replacing flat Jakafi revenue (FY26 guide unchanged at 3,220-3,270M) before loss of exclusivity, while absorbing a roughly 1,270M Q3 2026 IPR&D charge and converting ten H2 2026 readouts into launches (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). The bottleneck it relieves is VWD care, where patients currently need frequent intravenous factor infusions (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-06).
web_who_benefits_next: Mirum Pharmaceuticals commercializes Atebrioz in FOP from October 2026, with Incyte receiving milestones and mid-to-high single-digit royalties (Mirum 8-K, 2026-09-28; Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Star Therapeutics can earn up to 750M in sales milestones from the Vega deal (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-06). Halozyme gains ENHANZE collaboration economics for the subcutaneous INCA033989 (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28).
web_who_loses: JAK and hematology rivals lose share to Jakafi XR and Opzelura, and future generic ruxolitinib entrants face a weaker pricing path because the 2026-08-31 CMS agreement ties Jakafi/Jakafi XR Medicaid prices to other advanced nations and shields Incyte from proposed GUARD and GLOBE mandates (Incyte 8-K, 2026-08-31). VWD factor-replacement makers face latarcibart, a monthly subcutaneous option (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-06).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Jakafi loss of exclusivity or early generic entry, gross-to-net erosion, and failed pipeline readouts. Q3 2026 alone carries a roughly 1,270M IPR&D expense, and FY26 GAAP operating expense guidance jumped to 4,915-4,995M from 3,495-3,675M (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Cost of sales was already 7 percent of total net sales in Q2 2026 (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28).
web_low_cost_substitute: Not found as a specific dated product (2026-09-28). The structural low-cost substitute is generic ruxolitinib after Jakafi exclusivity ends; Incyte guides Jakafi flat at 3,220-3,270M for FY26 (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). No Chinese zilurgisertib or povorcitinib substitute was found in primary sources.
web_ceo_promised: CEO Bill Meury, 2026-07-28 Q2 release: With ten data readouts expected in the second half of 2026, alongside product launches through early next year, we are well positioned for our next phase of growth (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Same release set FY26 total net sales guidance of 5,130-5,260M and Opzelura of 1,050-1,100M (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28).
web_did_they_deliver: Yes so far. Opzelura FY26 guidance was raised from 750-790M (2026-02-10) to 1,050-1,100M and total net sales from 4,770-4,940M to 5,130-5,260M on 2026-07-28 (Incyte 8-K). Vega acquisition closed 2026-07-06, Jakafi XR was FDA approved in May 2026, and Minjuvi was approved in Japan in June 2026 (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28).
web_what_would_falsify: A Q3 2026 report (expected late October to early November 2026) cutting FY26 total net sales below 5,130M or Opzelura below 1,050M, or Jakafi net sales missing the 3,220-3,270M guide (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28). Also a failed H2 2026 readout among the ten promised, or a Monjuvi/Minjuvi US launch slipping past Q1 2027 (Incyte 8-K, 2026-07-28).
